user.title: foodpanda live tracker
user.description: Paste your foodpanda tokens. They can be found in the browser after logging in: F12 → Application → Cookies → www.foodpanda.com (the token, device_token, refresh_token and userSource cookies).

error.token_invalid: The token is invalid or expired (the API answered 401). Please log in to foodpanda again and paste a fresh token.
error.token_forbidden: The API rejected the request (HTTP 403). Please check that the user source is filled in and that the country code is right.
error.token_is_device_token: This is a device token, not an access token. Please paste the token cookie into this field and the device_token cookie into the Device token field.
error.user_source_required: The user source cannot be empty. Use volo.
error.cannot_connect: The foodpanda API could not be reached. Please check the network and try again.
